rules.tier: light: tris<=20000 & kb<=512; heavy: tris>60000 | kb>1024; còn lại medium
rules.parts: area-weighted UV samples, split by material x mirror flag (metal>=0.9 & rough<=0.15 per sample, not transmissive) then k-means, merge same kind+material dE<12, drop share<0.05, max 4
rules.completeness: visual-tags: drop unsure; value with >=2 votes and no rival with >=2
rules.front: heightmap 24x24 max-Y over XZ bbox; seats+beds: per-row/col mean height (rows with >=2 cells), band = max over a third; dz = band(-Z) - band(+Z), dx = |band(-X) - band(+X)|; dz>=0.12 & dz>dx -> ok measured; -dz>=0.12 & -dz>dx or dx>=0.12 & dx>|dz| -> suspect measured; else import. Other roles except fronted (desk,nightstand,dresser,cabinet,closet,bookshelf,tv,fridge,washer,basin,toilet,bathtub,shower): sim=1-sum|a-b|/sum(a+b) on occ*(0.3+0.7h); rot90 sim>=0.9 & bbox w/d in [0.9,1.1] -> sym all; rot180 sim>=0.9 -> sym rot180 (measured); else import
rules.shape: sofa: per-column front extent (rows); deep >= 0.9, shallow <= 0.75 of grid; L when a deep run at one end and a shallow run at the other each cover >= 0.25 of width
